tokens.TITLE: 5a1ive Eyewear: Wire-Wrapped Frames by 55555stuff
tokens.META_DESCRIPTION: 5a1ive rebuilds Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel and Burberry frames with aluminum wire and crystal — the 55555stuff eyewear line built for the nightlife scene.
tokens.KEYWORDS: 5a1ive, 5a1ive eyewear, 55555stuff shades, custom sunglasses, wire-wrapped sunglasses, Oakley custom, Ray-Ban custom, Burberry custom, nightlife eyewear, DGTL Influence
tokens.HEADLINE_GOLD: wires luxury frames for the night.
tokens.DEK: Beyond the watches, 5a1ive rebuilds Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel and Burberry eyewear with aluminum wire and crystal — the 55555stuff shades line, made, in the brand's words, for the nightlife scene.
tokens.HERO_CAPTION: A 5a1ive Oakley shield wrapped in aluminum wire — the CS3 from the 55555stuff shades line. Courtesy @5a1ive / 55555stuff.com.
tokens.STAT_FOOTNOTE: Styles and pricing from the 55555stuff Shades collection, as of July 2026.
tokens.LEAD: The 5a1ive signature doesn't stop at the wrist. Under 55555stuff, the Toronto designer takes luxury eyewear — Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel, Burberry — and rebuilds each pair with a lattice of aluminum wire and crystal, a look the brand pitches squarely at the nightlife scene.
tokens.BODY_1: It's the same instinct as the watches: take a recognisable object and make it stranger and more expensive-looking. A blue Oakley shield gets caged in fine silver wire; a pair of Ray-Bans is criss-crossed until the frame reads as sculpture; Diesel and Burberry frames get the same industrial-couture treatment. The result is eyewear that looks engineered rather than bought.
tokens.H2_1: Industrial couture, one pair at a time
tokens.BODY_2: Each style in the line carries a code and a base house — CS2 on Ray-Ban, BW1 and BW2 on Oakley, BW3 and CS1 on Diesel, CS4 on Burberry, CS3 on an Oakley shield. Prices run from about $525 to $615 USD. Like the watches, these are hand-built pieces, not a mass run — the wire is set by hand, so no two pairs sit exactly alike.
tokens.PULLQUOTE: Recognisable frames, rebuilt until they look engineered, not bought.
tokens.H2_2: Built for the scene it's photographed in
tokens.BODY_3: The 55555stuff aesthetic is explicit about where this lives — the store tags itself with cyberpunk, rocker and 2077 references, and the eyewear is designed for exactly that room: dark, loud, camera-heavy. It's the accessory version of the watch thesis, an object built to be seen at night. See the full range on the 55555stuff shades collection.
tokens.CALLOUT_1: Luxury frames — Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel, Burberry — rebuilt, not branded over.
tokens.CALLOUT_2: Hand-set aluminum wire and crystal on every pair.
tokens.CALLOUT_4: Designed for the nightlife scene the brand is built around.
tokens.BODY_4: For a fashion or nightlife brand, the eyewear line is proof the 5a1ive look extends past a single product — a consistent hand across categories is exactly what makes a designer worth building a campaign around.
tokens.STATCALLOUT_CAP: Luxury frames, rebuilt. The 55555stuff shades line reworks Ray-Ban, Oakley, Diesel and Burberry with aluminum wire and crystal — from about $525 USD a pair.
